text:
[ONLINE] Welcome to DEVJOHN // BRIDGE, John.

• 🎙️ Tap the Mic to send voice notes from your phone.
• 📎 Tap the Paperclip to send files/photos straight to ~/Desktop/PhoneBridge on your MacBook Air.
• 💻 Drop files into ~/Desktop/PhoneBridge/SendToPhone on your MacBook to push them to your phone.
• 📡 Check the 'Dev Radar' tab to inspect all your local repositories, branches, and uncommitted files in real time.
